purpose: Unit costs published by each CAISO Participating Transmission Owner for generator interconnection facilities and network upgrades (substation bays, transformers, gen-tie line, protection). This is the CAISO-side basis for estimating $/unit transmission upgrade cost, i.e. the c_F component that LBNL's dataset does not cover for CAISO.

sources.publisher: California ISO - PTO generator interconnection unit cost guides (2025)

conventions.cost: USD per unit, converted from the guides' $x1,000 scale
conventions.voltage_class: voltage column header as published (e.g. 60/70 kV, 115 kV, 230 kV, 500 kV)
conventions.unit: the guide's Units column (per unit, per mile, per substation, ...)

caveats: Unit costs are planning-grade estimates for interconnection study purposes, not bid prices.
Layouts differ between PTOs; rows with no voltage-specific value are kept with cost_usd null.
These are facility unit costs. A project's actual network upgrade obligation also depends on the cluster study allocation and the reimbursement / cost-containment caps in the accompanying PDFs.
